title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 111
description: Ten questions on Psalms 111: thanks with a whole heart for Yahweh's great works, his covenant, his holy name and the fear of Yahweh as the beginning of wisdom.

questions.text: How will the psalmist give thanks to Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Psalms 111:1 says: I will give thanks to Yahweh with my whole heart.

questions.text: Where will the psalmist give thanks?
questions.explanation: Psalms 111:1 says he will give thanks in the council of the upright, and in the congregation.

answers.text: In the council of the upright and the congregation
Alone on a mountain far from the people
In the courts of a foreign king's palace
On the shore of the sea among the ships

questions.explanation: Psalms 111:2 says Yahweh's works are great, pondered by all those who delight in them.

answers.text: All those who delight in them

questions.text: Which two words describe Yahweh in verse 4?
questions.explanation: Psalms 111:4 says: Yahweh is gracious and merciful.

questions.text: What has he given to those who fear him?
questions.explanation: Psalms 111:5 says he has given food to those who fear him and always remembers his covenant.

questions.text: How has he shown his people the power of his works?
questions.explanation: Psalms 111:6 says he has shown his people the power of his works in giving them the heritage of the nations.

answers.text: By raising up a mighty king to lead them
By sending them rain in its season
By giving them the heritage of the nations
By building them a temple of stone

questions.text: What are the works of his hands, according to verse 7?
questions.explanation: Psalms 111:7 says the works of his hands are truth and justice, and all his precepts are sure.

questions.text: What has he sent to his people?
questions.explanation: Psalms 111:9 says he has sent redemption to his people and ordained his covenant forever.
Psalms 111:9 says: his name is holy and awesome!

questions.text: What is the fear of Yahweh, according to the last verse?
questions.explanation: Psalms 111:10 says the fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom.
